verdict.rationale: The questionnaire evidence covers only the vendor-risk direction: sending security questionnaires to vendors, uploading questionnaire templates, and AI-assisted review of vendor due-diligence responses (sprinto-docs-9, -34, -42, -43). Nothing shows AI drafting answers to inbound customer questionnaires from Sprinto's own controls or a knowledge base. That is an adjacent feature and earns no credit, while the axis clearly applies to a compliance automation platform.
